title: Releasing my third game (but the first fun one)
author: TonyDaDesigner
selftext:
I've been salty that they removed Fight Night Mobile from the App Store for years. I've always loved fighting games and wished more of them would implement mechanics from actual fighting.  So, six months ago, I started building a fighting game that aimed to implement fight night style head movement into a more arcade-themed experience.   

This is actually not my first game nor my first fighting game.  Over ten years ago, I made and released a 2.5D fighting game called Hood Fight 3D. I built the game using Unity and the Universal Fight Game Engine.  The game was ended up having some serious issues that I couldn't fix easily, so I pulled the game from distribution. Aside from some game-breaking bugs and just not being "fun," I learned from user reviews that the character models I purchased on TurboSquid were stolen from an existing fighting game. It was extremely demoralizing after spending a long time on the project. 

So I learned my lesson- I focused on making everything myself. From the art, sounds, levels to the actual gameplay code. Although I used Godot as the primary engine, I built all of the gameplay mechanics from scratch.  It took about 6 months, with at least two months working 60+ hour weeks, but it's finally done. 

  
I used AI heavily in this project and I'm not shy or ashamed of it.  My full stack was: Meshy for character models, WorldLabs Marble for creating backgrounds, ElevenLabs for voices and sound effects. Gemini and Minimax for music. Google Veo/Omni for generating video. Codex put everything together and kept things moving.  The only human-made assets I used were the animations, which were licensed from a motion capture guy.  It was a challenge getting the high quality gaussian splats running on an iPhone without it overheating in 30 seconds but some clever tricks got it working well.

I don't consider the game completely "done." I am tweaking some gameplay mechanics and will continue to improve the online experience.  

I would highly appreciate if you check the game out and let me know what you think. 

  
[Hood Fight: Locked Up   Free on Apple App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hood-fight-locked-up/id6798000913)

comments.author: Feline_Fan
comments.body: Will this game be released on PC?

replies.author: TonyDaDesigner
replies.body: Likely. Right now just iOS and Macs. Going with Apple exclusively made multiplayer and matchmaking a lot easier. Game Center is pretty great for this.

replies.author: Feline_Fan
replies.body: Is there a single player mode?  Thanks for considering a PC release.

replies.author: TonyDaDesigner
replies.body: Yes. Story mode, quick fight and riot survival mode are all single player

replies.author: Feline_Fan
replies.body: Thanks, I'll wait for the Windows PC release.
